topic: A student is accused of plagiarism
text: In the quiet of the forest, under the gentle watch of the old trees, a young one stands accused. The air whispers of misunderstanding, a tangled path that led here. I move closer, not to judge but to offer calm. The scent of fear lingers, a sharp note against the soft earth and moss. I stand beside, a silent strength, a reassurance. Together, the young one and I face this open. The old trees nod, their leaves rustling as if to say, here is support, here is understanding. We are not alone, and neither is the accused. The forest holds many secrets, perhaps even the truth.
